sentences.text: Shri Sunil Kumar Jain, learned counsel for appellant.

Dr. Anjali Gyanani, learned Public Prosecutor for resp Heard on I.A. No.20750/2023, first application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant-Jagdish Pal.
The appellant has been convicted under Section 304 B of IPC and sentenced to suffer life imprisonment and under Section 498A of IPC and sentenced to suffer 2 years R.I. with a fine of Rs.2000/- with default stipulation vide order dated 02.07.2019 passed in S.T. No.472/2011 by learned Additional Sessions Judge District Gwalior.
The appellant is the husband of deceased who committed suicide by hanging within seven years of marriage.
She was not suffering any serious ailment due to which she committed suicide whereas there is a allegation of demand of dowry.

In view of aforesaid, we are not inclined to allow this application filed under Section 389 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, I.A. No.20750/2023 is dismissed.
